summary: Layered on top of through-task-016a (Tasks 1-13, the Context + Skill Fabric, Task 14, Task 15, and Task 16A, unchanged): Task 16B is now accepted history. GET /admin/field is a new, additive, project-scoped field PM dashboard pilot, alongside the unchanged legacy GET / and GET /admin PM dashboard and the unchanged Task 16A GET /admin/operator panel (all three coexist). It reuses createSubmissionKernel (extended with an optional per-action storage key so multiple concurrent project/kind actions each get an independent pending/resolved slot, rather than a second identity implementation) and the same PM-intelligence field-mapping functions -- no new forecasting/predictive logic, no operator-core changes. All per-project state (health/recovery caches, per-action workflow state, in-flight tracking, sessionStorage pending-submission identities) is keyed by stable projectId (and projectId+intentKind for per-action state), never by mutable render index, so a delayed response or a removed/reordered project can never land in the wrong project's slot. Each of the 5 canonical action kinds (FORECAST_QUERY, FORECAST_HEALTH_QUERY, RECOVERY_QUERY, EVIDENCE_PREVIEW, EVIDENCE_APPLY_SHADOW) owns its own independent workflow/Resume state, rendered as a compact 'Active workflows / Needs attention' list; a sibling kind's SUCCEEDED result cannot hide another kind's still-unresolved INTERRUPTED workflow. Resume shares the exact same projectId+kind in-flight ownership lock as a fresh submission for that project+kind (not a separate key), so a mutation workflow's Resume and a fresh submission for the same kind can never run concurrently, while sibling kinds and other projects remain fully concurrent; the evidence-run control's busy state reflects only the currently-selected kind. Removing a project always takes it off the tracked list, but its backing state (health/recovery caches, per-kind workflow state, sessionStorage identities) is purged only once every kind's state is a resolved, inactive outcome -- an in-flight request, an uncertain (PENDING) delivery, or an unresumed INTERRUPTED workflow for that project is preserved across removal, and a shared maybePurgeUntrackedProject helper re-evaluates purge-safety after every action/Resume settlement (not just at removal time), so a still-active project made purge-safe later is still cleaned up without requiring the operator to re-add/remove it. Evidence actions (including EVIDENCE_APPLY_SHADOW) are never auto-fired; only explicit per-project Refresh/Run-evidence-action clicks submit. Task 17 is not accepted. No deployment.
